title: Nuevas repúblicas
goal: Read why winning independence turned out to be the easy part: wrecked economies, almost no local administrative experience, and a London lending bubble that collapsed within years.

items: Describe the economic condition the new republics inherited.
Explain what happened to the London debt bubble between 1822 and 1825.
Explain why there were so few experienced administrators available.
Explain why many regions turned to strong military leaders.
Use 'a raíz de' and 'en el marco de' to explain causes and context together.
